title: Spark
description: The frontmatter of a spark (Sp): an idea in the incubator, held until it is hot enough to become a mission. Filed by identifier alone, Sp001.md.

type.description: the word Spark, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this spark's identifier, Sp and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

heat.description: how close the idea is to being flown: cold, warm or hot

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

raised_by.description: who raised the idea, the commander or the pilot

context.description: the identifiers the idea came out of, a bracketed list

generates.description: the identifiers this spark became, a bracketed list, usually the mission it was promoted into
